integrity: The meromorphic identity follows from the cited positive Dirichlet series and an elementary Stirling rational generating function. The proof checks the nonreal-pole hypotheses needed for the cited oscillation theorem and separates the previously available leading term from the new obstruction. Exact finite computations verify formal algebra only; they are not infinite verification.
limitations: Fixed m at least 3. No effective pole heights, error constants, error upper bound, or uniformity in m. Simultaneous pole replication uses standard almost-periodicity and Rouche; the two-sided Omega implication invokes a published general theorem. The priority of an equivalent earlier application is not independently established.
title: Simultaneous near-edge Dirichlet poles and oscillation in sum-system counts
